title: Environment and Global Variables Configuration
description: Schema for environment configurations and global variables used in Floweb automation flows

globalVariables.description: List of global variables available across all environments

selectedEnvironmentId.description: ID of the currently selected environment

Environment.description: An environment configuration with its variables. Unifies the standalone-entity and embedded-in-flow forms: only id+name are required so embedded partial environments validate; the server always sets the remaining fields on stored environments.

isDefault.description: Whether this is the default environment

isActive.description: Whether this environment is currently active

createdAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the environment was created

updatedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the environment was last updated

GlobalVariable.description: A global variable available across all environments

id.description: Unique identifier for the global variable

value.description: The variable's value; any JSON value is allowed (2026-07 decision: runtime stores structured values, aligned with TS JsonValue rather than the old string-only contract)

secret.description: When true, the value is a secret: write-only for UI clients (masked in API responses, never returned as plaintext), redacted from reports and logs, and sent in plaintext only to the engine runtime context. Set automatically when type is `secret`.

createdAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the variable was created

updatedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the variable was last updated

Variable.description: A variable (environment, global, or flow parameter). Field constraints are strict; `value` accepts any JSON value.

value.description: The variable's value; any JSON value is allowed (2026-07 decision: runtime stores structured values, aligned with TS JsonValue rather than the old string-only contract)

isOutput.description: Whether this is an output variable (flow parameters)

secret.description: When true, the value is a secret: write-only for UI clients (masked in API responses, never returned as plaintext), redacted from reports and logs, and sent in plaintext only to the engine runtime context. Set automatically when type is `secret`.
